name: arraySet
description:
In a one-dimensional array, sets the elements in a specified
index range to a value. Useful for initializing an array after
a call to ArrayNew.
syntax: arraySet( array array, number start_pos, number end_pos, any value )

params.name: start_pos
params.description: Starting index position of range to set.

params.name: end_pos
params.description: Ending index position of range to set. If this value is greater than array length, Lucee adds elements to array.

params.name: value
params.description: Value to which to set each element in the range.
